context:
Goal: a change that keeps failing review ends cleanly, and the stronger model is used only where it earns its cost.
Problem (rule): you saw an Opus "final round". That was the builder's third try (Opus, by standing grant) after a round 2 FAIL, together with the old reviewer round 3. Your 14:01 CST words: round 3 stays for a change that failed round 2; only the round 3 forced after a pass is gone. So the third try still happens. The question is only the model for it.
Based on (ruling): r9, newest text 14:01 CST Nov 13 (corrected from the 13:29 CST reading); rule roles-third-round-steps-up, which runs a builder's third try on Opus.
Departs from: main CLAUDE.md, where roles-third-round-steps-up runs the builder's third try on Opus — option b would run it on the builder's own row (Sonnet).
Meanwhile: the third try keeps running on Opus; lane rounds-rules-one-record waits on your pick for the CLAUDE.md wording.

options.gain: A stronger model gets one more go on a change that failed twice.
options.label: Keep Opus for the third try (recommended)

options.gain: Lower cost; one builder model throughout.
options.label: Run the third try on the builder's own row (Sonnet)
options.lose: A stubborn change gets no step-up, so it may fail round 3 more often (unmeasured).

reply: Triage 14:0x CST: your 14:05 CST words ("i shuld never be prompted we shd change this -- no opus round 3 here just sonnnet high") are filed as ruling own-r3-reviewer-sonnet-high: the reviewer's round 3 runs Sonnet high and Opus is not an option for it. I read that as the reviewer only. Does it also cover the builder's third try? If yes, pick b here; if the builder's third try may still use Opus, pick a.
short: Builder third try: Opus or the builder's own model?
title: The builder's third try, after a round 2 FAIL: should it still run on Opus, or on the builder's own model?
why: It sets the model for the third try in rule roles-third-round-steps-up; the try itself stays.
